caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden table with a reddish-brown finish. The tabletop is elongated with slightly rounded corners and beveled edges. It has two drawers in the front, each adorned with a circular brass handle that resembles a ring held by a sculpted lion's head. The table stands on four fluted, tapered legs connected in pairs by carved, curved stretchers. Each leg ends in a decorative brass paw foot, supported by small dark wheels or casters. The overall design includes detailed wood grain patterns and carved ornamental accents, with the table set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Sofa Table
